title: Healthy Infant Development Project
brief_summary: The Healthy Infant Development Project will determine if providing micronutrient supplements to mothers during pregnancy and infants in the first 9 months fosters healthy behavior and development in babies.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Full-term healthy neonates born to study mothers from CDC's Prenatal Nutrition Study with randomly selected lot numbers.

Exclusion Criteria:

* birth weight \< 2500 g
* gestational age ≤ 37 wk
* major perinatal complications
* major congenital anomaly
* multiple birth.
